description: Questions over the REAL NewsOnAIR dataset indexed on 2026-11-02 (80 articles, 8 English bulletins). Every expectation was taken from the indexed text: expected_docs are doc ids (prefix match), must_mention phrases appear in the source article or transcript. Extra checks: expected_category (all sources from that NewsOnAIR category), genre (passed as the UI genre scope; all sources must have it), require_audio (at least one cited transcript source with an audio time range), check_source_urls (every source links to newsonair.gov.in). If the dataset is re-ingested later, newer stories may outrank these; regenerate the set from the new content.
